row.title: Q-WORKERS-201: routes and ports of the build-out modules wired into core/org
row.body: Mounts (walkthrough, dashboard, proxy guide) run inside handleConsole's signed-in surface so they are owner-only by construction; model port, stage2 tracker and slots are supplied by createOrg (workers/core/org/surfaces.js). scheduledTick() is what schedulers call; tick() stays unconditional so tests and manual runs are never throttled. The retired ultrastable/workers repo was unarchived only to close its issues; all code changes go in ultrastable/ultrastable workers/.
